podcast.body: Originally released in 1969, Bowie's album was re-promoted in 1973 by RCA Records under the title "Space Oddity." This re-promotion included new post-Ziggy Stardust imagery and a new video of Bowie miming the song in glam makeup, capitalizing on his recent album success. "RCA Records, Bowie's American label, decided to re-promote his 1969 album, under the title Space Audity, with new post-Ziggy Stardust imagery and even a new video of Bowie miming the song in glam makeup."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.body: This album marks the beginning of David Bowie's early work recorded at Trident Studios, starting in 1969. "Starting with Space Audity in 1969, through two pit ups in 1973."
